description: Theme selection: color mode and theme (a select of every theme, or a short list as swatches), as a popover or inline panel

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: popover: trigger + floating panel; inline: always-visible panel

attributes.name: themes
attributes.description: Space-separated theme ids to offer, in that order (default: every theme). Unknown ids are ignored; the visitor's current theme is added if it is not listed

attributes.name: swatches
attributes.description: Theme chooser is a grid of colour swatches instead of a <select>; meant for a short themes list

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected state only — set by open()/close()/toggle(), not intended as initial markup (popover variant only)

attributes.name: data-label-mode
attributes.description: Color mode legend and radiogroup label (i18n override)

attributes.name: data-label-theme
attributes.description: Legend and accessible name of the theme chooser

childAttributes.name: data-trigger
childAttributes.description: Marks the popover trigger (else the first child <button>; else a generated type=button icon trigger)

methods.name: open()
methods.description: Open the popover and move focus into it (popover variant only)

a11y.pattern: Non-modal dialog with native form controls
a11y.provide: Optionally a trigger button with an accessible name; a labelled palette button is generated when none is authored

keyboard.action: Close the panel and move focus to the trigger
keyboard.when: Popover variant with the panel open, focus anywhere on the page
